Class ByteBodyElements<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.body.stream.PulledBodyElements<T>
io.micronaut.http.client.ByteBodyElements<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of an element
All Implemented Interfaces:
BodyElements<T>, AutoCloseable, Subscriber<ReadBuffer>
@Internal public final class ByteBodyElements<T> extends PulledBodyElements<T> implements Subscriber<ReadBuffer>
The elements of a body, read from the body one piece at a time as they are asked for, without Reactor: a read with no decoded element left requests the next piece of the body, and a piece that completes no element requests another one. The elements of a piece are decoded together.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • demand

      protected void demand()
      Description copied from class: PulledBodyElements
      Ask the source for more elements. Called by a read that found nothing available, outside the lock. The source answers with PulledBodyElements.push(T), PulledBodyElements.end() or PulledBodyElements.fail(Throwable); a source that produced nothing for the read must ask itself again while PulledBodyElements.isWaiting().
      Specified by:
      demand in class PulledBodyElements<T>
